subject: general
question: Under the Prime Minister's Internship Scheme launched in October 2024, candidates will receive a monthly stipend of what amount for the full 12-month internship period?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹5,000**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Under the** Prime Minister's Internship Scheme** launched in October 2024, selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend of** ₹5,000 for the full 12-month internship perio**d.
 
• This stipend comprises ₹**4,500 provided by the government and an additional ₹500 con**tributed by participating companies from their Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) fund
 
• The scheme** aims to provide** young graduates with practical experience, skill development opportunities, and industry exposure.
 
• This aligns with the g**overnment's goal of enhancing youth employability **and bridging the gap between academic learning and industry requirements.

68:T96
